notes.title: Update June 03 : Max Score
notes.content:
[h1]Bugs / Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] No longer allow score to be higher than the max value of an Int32 (ie 2147483647) to comply with Valve leaderboard requirements
[*] Add dynamic font for score in menu
[*] Correct some glyphs
[*] Tone down interface sounds
[*] Other minor corrections
[/list]

tags.bug: No longer allow score to be higher than the max value of an Int32 (ie 2147483647) to comply with Valve leaderboard requirements

tags.feature: Add dynamic font for score in menu

tags.bug: Correct some glyphs
Other minor corrections
